branding.subtext: COD, cash handovers, cash sessions, variances and reconciliations — for authorized NOKI internal Finance staff only.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.description: Real-time Finance KPIs: COD, cash, sessions, variances and payouts.

states.emptyDescription: No Finance metrics are available for your current scope.
states.errorDescription: Unable to load Finance data from NOKI API. Retry or contact support with the reference below.
states.sessionStatusNote: Only the open session count is aggregated by this metric. See Cash sessions for the full detail.
states.varianceNote: Aggregate of open variances only. See Variances for a prioritized list.
